content.Title: Clinical Practice Guidelines Committee 2022-2024 - Declarations of Interest
content.Summary: Declarations of interest reported by the expert during yearly calls covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during guideline development up to and including 2023).

TypeOfRelationship: Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc.
PASSpaces (training/education): acts as a patient for trainees to take a patient history.
Travel and meeting support from healthcare industry: payment of hotel, travel and meals to attend or speak at ESC conferences.

Membership/affiliation with charities and advocacy groups: supports British charity CardiomyopathyUK and Pumping Marvellous; member of Coalition for Reducing Bureaucracy in Clinical Trials (no financial interest).
Other interests: savings and pensions held in shares managed by a financial adviser; no control over purchase & sale and uncertain whether any shares are in medical companies.
Entries.AdditionalDetails: PASSpaces: http://passpaces.co.uk/. European Society of Cardiology: payment of hotel, travel and meals. British charity CardiomyopathyUK: https://www.cardiomyopathy.org.uk/. Pumping Marvellous: https://pumpingmarvellous.org/. Coalition for Reducing Bureaucracy in Clinical Trials: https://bureaucracyincts.eu/.

TypeOfRelationship: Payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, including travel funding related to these activities.
Participation in NICE (National Institute for Health & Care Excellence) - UK Government body: guideline development (Chronic Heart Failure) commencing January 2024.
PASSpaces training/education: acts as a patient for trainees.
Funding from healthcare industry for travel to, and attendance of events and meetings (unrelated to other listed activities).
European Society of Cardiology: payment of hotel, travel and meals to attend or speak at ESC conferences.
Entries.AdditionalDetails: PASSpaces: http://passpaces.co.uk/. NICE involvement: guideline development for Chronic Heart Failure.
